channel.title: CRA: Truth & Consequences | Jim Mckenney

channel.description: Uncompromising, hard-hitting investigative monologues on the hidden commercial liabilities, conflicting stakeholder perspectives, and raw statutory facts of EU product cybersecurity.

item.title: [TC_01] The Edge-to-Cloud Grey Zone: When Microservices Void Local Controller CE Marks
item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: The Edge-to-Cloud Grey Zone: When Microservices Void Local Controller CE Marks. Shattering the myth: 'Cloud container updates to an edge gateway are purely IT operations and have nothing to do with physical machine CE marking.' with cold statutory facts.

item.title: [TC_02] The Defunct OEM Dilemma: Who Patches Brownfield OT When the Vendor Goes Bankrupt?
item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: The Defunct OEM Dilemma: Who Patches Brownfield OT When the Vendor Goes Bankrupt?. Shattering the myth: 'If the automation manufacturer went out of business, the asset owner is legally off the hook for unpatched vulnerabilities.' with cold statutory facts.

item.title: [TC_03] Autonomous AI & Neural Weights on the Plant Floor: Harmonizing CRA and the EU AI Act
item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: Autonomous AI & Neural Weights on the Plant Floor: Harmonizing CRA and the EU AI Act. Shattering the myth: 'AI model weights are mathematical parameters, not software, so continuous on-device learning doesn't trigger regulatory recertification.' with cold statutory facts.

item.title: [TC_04] The Open-Source Steward's Balance Sheet: How Foundations & Dual-License Models Survive CRA
item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: The Open-Source Steward's Balance Sheet: How Foundations & Dual-License Models Survive CRA. Shattering the myth: 'Open source is 100% exempt from the CRA, so companies can build commercial products on unpaid GitHub libraries without legal risk.' with cold statutory facts.

item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: Cross-Border Supply Chain Sanctions: How EU Market Surveillance Intercepts Firmware with Backdoors. Shattering the myth: 'European customs only checks CE paper declarations and doesn't inspect actual microcontroller code or hardware circuits.' with cold statutory facts.

item.title: [TC_06] The Decommissioning & End-of-Life Handover: Legal Liabilities When Retiring Critical OT
item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney
item.description: Hard-hitting investigative case study: The Decommissioning & End-of-Life Handover: Legal Liabilities When Retiring Critical OT. Shattering the myth: 'Once an industrial machine is decommissioned or auctioned off, the manufacturer and operator have zero ongoing CRA legal obligations.' with cold statutory facts.

item.itunes:author: Jim Mckenney

Shattering the myth: 'A 5,000-kilometer subsea cable or low-Earth-orbit satellite constellation is an infrastructure project, so individual sensors and repeaters don't need CRA conformity.' with cold statutory facts.
